lines.zh: 我飘着走，翅膀扇得很急。
lines.en: I drift along, wings beating fast.
I giggle as I fly.
I turn half a circle around a trunk.

lines.zh: 我飞到离地两格的地方。
lines.en: I rise two blocks above the ground.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀把落叶吹起来。
lines.en: My wings lift the fallen leaves.
I thread between the treetops.
I fly high, then low, then high.
I watch you while I fly.

lines.zh: 我绕着一根枝转了三圈。
lines.en: I circle a branch three times.
I skim across the grass tops.

lines.zh: 我停下来，又忽然飞起来。
lines.en: I stop, then suddenly take off.

lines.zh: 我的笑声在林子里回响。
lines.en: My laughter echoes through the wood.

lines.zh: 我悬在半空，翅膀不停地扇。
lines.en: I hover with my wings never still.

lines.zh: 我又笑了一声，没别的意思。
lines.en: I giggle again, for no reason.
The umbrella handle turns in my hand.
A bird flew past me.
My parasol is folded, not yet open.
I spin a dart between my fingers.
I dangle my legs from a branch.

lines.zh: 树上有个巢，我飞过去看了看。
lines.en: There is a nest up there. I went and looked.
I hang from a branch by one hand, swinging.
I laugh again, louder this time.
Look up and I will giggle for you.
I am right above your head.
Tell me. Should I laugh?
You are not looking high enough.
I fly faster than you walk.

lines.zh: 你手里那把东西，够不到我。
lines.en: That will never reach me.
I pop my umbrella and I'm gone.
I visit that tree behind you often.

lines.zh: 我在这儿待了一整天了。
lines.en: I have been here all day.
Hold still and let me look at you.
One umbrella pop and I drift away.

lines.zh: 我飞不稳，往下降了一格。
lines.en: I lose my hover and drop a block.
My giggle sticks in my throat.
A tear has opened in my parasol.
I retreat into the tree and grip a branch.
I gasp once, then start laughing again.
Something on me is bleeding.
My fingers are trembling.
One of my umbrella ribs is bent.
I can still fly. That will do.
That thing in your hand is shiny.

lines.zh: 我飞近了一点，又退回去。
lines.en: I came closer, then withdrew.
I reached out and pulled back.

lines.zh: 这东西能吃吗，我不太在乎。
lines.en: Is it edible? I hardly care.
I only want to look.
Leave it still. I will take it myself.
I grabbed and caught nothing.

lines.zh: 这点东西不够换我的时间。
lines.en: That is not worth my time.
Once I have it I fly high.
Do not chase. I am quick.

lines.zh: 你撞到了空气，我在上面。
lines.en: You hit empty air. I am above.

lines.zh: 别挥手，会打到我的翅膀。
lines.en: Do not swat. You will hit my wing.
I retreat a block, still laughing.
That bump made me wobble.
I skim over the top of your head.
You cannot reach me. Stop trying.
I open my umbrella and drift up a block.
Your stick hit the branch.
I rose another half block.
Jump as you like. You cannot reach.

lines.zh: 林子里还有一只，笑得更尖。
lines.en: There is another in the wood with a shriller laugh.
We laugh at each other across two trees.
It is smaller, with a red parasol.
Neither of us ever lands.

lines.zh: 有一次我们一起追同一只虫。
lines.en: Once we chased the same insect.
I won, and it stopped speaking to me.
Three days later it started laughing again.

lines.zh: 我们的笑声听起来一样。
lines.en: Our laughter sounds the same.
No one can tell which of us is laughing.
That suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我从树枝上摘了一颗果子。
lines.en: I picked a fruit off a branch.
I have snatched that up.

lines.zh: 我拿在手里看了看，扔了。
lines.en: I looked at it and threw it away.
It fell to the ground and I will not go down.
I hold it in both hands.
It swings in my grip.
I tuck it inside my clothes.
I do not want it. Too heavy.
Startled, I open my umbrella and flee.
I pick my dart back up.
Something moves on the ground.
I lower my head and see it clearly.
That is a living thing.
I fold my parasol tighter.
I giggle from behind my umbrella.
I come around behind it.

lines.zh: 飞镖在手，这个高度正好。
lines.en: Dart in hand, this height is right.
I stop two blocks above it.
I giggle and it does not hear.
It walks on. I follow.

lines.zh: 我把手伸到背后摸飞镖。
lines.en: I reach behind for a dart.
It stopped to tie a lace.

lines.zh: 我把飞镖一枚枚摸出来。
lines.en: I draw the darts out one by one.
I have its heading worked out.
The canopy hides me well.
It has stopped in an open patch.
I follow it a stretch.
It looks up and I drift higher.
It looks down again.
I slip to its other side.
Its shadow is below me.
It took a few steps. I counted them.

lines.zh: 风把我的笑声送过去了。
lines.en: The wind carries my laugh to it.
It stops and scans around.
I am in the canopy where it cannot find me.
I laugh again, on purpose this time.
It moves again, same heading.
I aim through a gap in the leaves.
I hold the dart ready.
It reaches the open ground. Perfect.
When I move, the leaves answer.
The dart has already left my hand.

lines.zh: 我笑着跟，声音越飘越远。
lines.en: I follow laughing, the sound drifting.
It circles once under the tree.
I slide into the leaf shadow.

lines.zh: 它往上看的时间越来越长。
lines.en: It stares upward longer each time.
I snap my wrist and the dart flies.
It goes into its shoulder.
I laugh as I throw.
It throws up a hand and misses.
I draw another from my sleeve.
A dart drops from above.
It swings wildly and hits nothing.
I circle behind it and throw again.
This one sticks in its leg.
It dropped to a knee and rose again.
I never land. I stay above.

lines.zh: 它抬头找我，我在另一侧笑。
lines.en: It looks up; I laugh from the other side.
A dart grazes its ear.
I throw one from its left.

lines.zh: 再一枚，射在它的手背上。
lines.en: Another takes it on the back of the hand.

lines.zh: 它把武器扔过来，太高了。
lines.en: It throws its weapon. Too high.
I drop lower and throw again.
I laugh louder.
It covers its head and crouches.

lines.zh: 我停在它够不到的高度上。
lines.en: I hang at a height it cannot reach.
I drift out from among the branches.
I laugh once before I show myself.

lines.zh: 我的伞还收着，红得像果子。
lines.en: My parasol is folded, red as a berry.

lines.zh: 这片林子是我的游乐场。
lines.en: This wood is my playground.
The birds leave when I appear.

lines.zh: 我在空中停了一下，看了看下面。
lines.en: I pause in the air and look down.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有一层薄薄的光。
lines.en: A thin sheen lies on my wings.

lines.zh: 这棵树比我上次来时更高。
lines.en: This tree is taller than when I last came.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，找个好位置。
lines.en: I circle once for a good spot.

lines.zh: 我在一根细枝上坐了一会儿。
lines.en: I sit on a thin branch a while.
Something is walking below.
I open my parasol a little.
Fire caught my parasol and I let it go.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀停了，我直直坠下。
lines.en: My wings gave out and I dropped straight down.
I fell in and my wings sank.
The blast threw me against a trunk.

lines.zh: 一枚东西扎进我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something stuck in my wing.
Strange light keeps me from rising.

lines.zh: 我饿了很久，笑声都轻了。
lines.en: Hungry so long my laugh is thin.
Lightning struck and I jolted all over.

lines.zh: 底下的树没了，我在往下坠。
lines.en: The trees are gone and I am falling.
